parsed_json.up: Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL299. Join molecule_dictionary to activities to assays to target_dictionary, and join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', pchembl_value IS NOT NULL, and target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL299'. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
